exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. Vaginal delivery)
outcome: Neonatal blood glucose level at 2 hours of life
cohort: The study included 164 neonates, comprising 85 delivered via Caesarean section and 79 via vaginal delivery.
finding: Cord and neonatal blood glucose levels at 2 hours of life were significantly lower in neonates delivered via Caesarean section compared to those delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Cord and neonatal blood glucose levels were significantly lower in neonates who were delivered via Caesarean section compared to those delivered vaginally.
cross-section timing: At birth (cord blood) and 2 hours of life
